items.title: openSUSE Leap 16.1
items.blurb: This is the first minor release in the Leap 16 series and with this release, openSUSE’s immutable server distribution, Leap Micro, becomes part of Leap itself through a new Immutable Mode. Comments

items.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances in additional AWS Regions
items.blurb: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances in additional AWS Regions.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools in flows
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now enables you to invoke Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools in customer experience flows through the new 'External Tool' block.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports Cases and External Tool events in the Wait block
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now supports Cases and External Tool events in the Wait block, giving you more control over how your customer experience flows react to real-time data changes.

items.title: EC2 Amazon Machine Images can now be scanned for vulnerabilities through Amazon Inspector
items.blurb: Amazon Inspector now extends its vulnerability scanning to EC2 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), enabling you to identify software vulnerabilities in your AMIs without launching instances or installing additional software.

items.title: Amazon Textract now available in Asia Pacific (Tokyo) and Europe (Zurich)
items.blurb: Amazon Textract is now available in the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) and Europe (Zurich) Regions.

items.title: Announcing AWS for Fluent Bit 3.0.0 based on Fluent Bit 4.1.1
items.blurb: AWS for Fluent Bit announces version 3.0.0 , based on Fluent Bit version 4.1.1 and Amazon Linux 2023.
